title: Claim ready to close: all tasks done, all sections resolved (prototype demo preset, no Jira source)
walkthroughSteps: Demo preset made by the prototype: no Jira or Confluence source. Land on CLM-2024-001 overview: status chip reads 'Open'

walkthroughSteps.title: All tasks done
walkthroughSteps.body: Every task on this claim is marked Done, the Tasks widget shows 0 pending.

walkthroughSteps: Sections are all resolved too, no open deductibles, salvage, litigation, reserves, payments, or provider blockers remain

walkthroughSteps.title: Close Claim
walkthroughSteps.body: With every task done and no section blockers left, Close Claim opens the popup with nothing blocking.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the closure popup at Step 2, the Pre-closure Checklist with every row green. Step 1 (blockers) is skipped because nothing blocks.

walkthroughSteps: Press Continue, pick a Closure reason and retention, Continue, then Yes: Close Claim on the confirmation
Status chip updates to 'Closed'; closure panel appears with date, reason, and handler

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All tasks completed: Tasks widget shows 0 pending
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Prototype demo preset: no Jira or Confluence source.** It only sets up a claim with nothing blocking closure, for testing.

Every task on CLM-2024-001 is marked **Done**, the Tasks widget on the overview shows **0 pending tasks**.

setup.description: All 5 tasks for CLM-2024-001 set to done; all sections closed

preconditions.hint: All task rows should have 'Done' status badge
All section rows show Closed status
Button is active: no tooltip blocker on hover

expectedUI.description: Overview shows fully resolved claim, all tasks done, all sections closed, Close Claim enabled
visualCues: Tasks widget: 0 pending, all rows show Done badge
Sections widget: all rows show Closed status
Close Claim button is active (not greyed out)

howToTest.trigger: Observe Tasks widget and Sections widget on load
howToTest.expectedResult: 0 pending tasks, all sections closed, Close Claim button enabled

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Close Claim popup opens at Step 2 (Pre-closure Checklist), no blocker step shown
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Clicking **Close Claim** opens the popup **directly at Step 2, Close Claim: Pre-closure Checklist**, with every row green and **Continue** enabled. Step 1 (blockers) is skipped because nothing blocks. The reason and retention come next, at Step 3.

setup.description: Same state as AC-01: all tasks done, all sections cleared

preconditions.hint: Click it to open the closure modal

preconditions.text: Popup opens at Step 2, the Pre-closure Checklist, all rows green
preconditions.hint: No blocker checklist step shown before the reason form

expectedUI.description: Closure popup at Step 2, all checklist rows green, no blocker list
visualCues: Popup header reads 'Close Claim: Pre-closure Checklist'
Every checklist row has a green check icon
Continue is enabled and leads to Close Claim: Reason & Retention

howToTest.expectedResult: Popup opens at the Pre-closure Checklist with all rows green; no blocker list
